name: Lost Shipping Crate
summary: Friz Frazzlespark’s Lost Shipping Crate bears a warning against opening it without supervision. Its label directs you to return it to Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

sections.title: The Crate’s Label
sections.body: A handwritten label on the Lost Shipping Crate names Friz Frazzlespark and Powderfuse Port. It warns against tampering or opening the crate without supervision, then asks that it be returned to Friz at the port in the Riverglades.

faq.q: Who owns the Lost Shipping Crate?
faq.answer: The label names Friz Frazzlespark as the crate’s owner.

faq.q: Where should I take the crate?
faq.answer: The label directs you to return the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
The handwritten label warns against tampering with or opening the crate without supervision, and says to return it to Friz Frazzlespark.

faq.q: What is shown on the crate’s map?
faq.answer: The label’s map marks a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and winged creatures.
